title: Speckle workflows and connector status
description: Explore Speckle workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Speckle

Speckle

Speckle provides open data infrastructure for exchanging, versioning and collaborating on AEC information.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Send selected model data

Start from the controlled identifier, current revision and relationship context. In the intended Speckle preview, send selected model data; the visible result is the matching record, document or model tree with ownership visible. Review source system, revision, permissions and record identity before accepting or exporting it.

Compare a version change

Begin with the proposed change, exchange or coordination package. In the intended Speckle preview, compare a version change; the visible result is a versioned change set with affected objects and approvals exposed. Review scope, dependencies, recipients and comparison accuracy before accepting or exporting it.

Coordinate a reviewed data exchange

Use the release, transmittal or review criteria. In the intended Speckle preview, coordinate a reviewed data exchange; the visible result is a traceable status view with history and outstanding decisions. Review approvers, effective revision, audit trail and delivery state before accepting or exporting it.
